versions.changelog:
- No code or documentation changes in this release.
- Replaced a single name in skill.md in an example code.
- Version increment only; no new features or bug fixes.

- Added an auto-scan option to detect OpenClaw workspace and executable paths, improving usability for installation.
- Clarified installation steps to support both automatic detection and manual input of required paths.
- Updated metadata to include supported platforms (Windows) and dependencies (openclaw, powershell, schtasks, taskkill).
- No code or asset changes; documentation and instructions updated for smoother setup.

bunni-modes 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Introduces Bunni, a persona for OpenClaw with SFW (Coding/Security) and NSFW (Companion) modes.
- Provides batch scripts for instant switching between Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek models.
- Includes a step-by-step installation wizard guiding through user info collection, backup, configuration, and shortcut creation.
- Personalizes persona files and scripts based on user preferences and paths.
- Emphasizes safe installation with mandatory backups and post-installation mode-switching instructions.
